blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alternergy Holdings Corp., a listed renewable energy producer, raised P2 billion from its maiden fixed-rate notes issuance, giving the group fresh capital to support its expansion. On Tuesday, the company listed the corporate notes on the Philippine Dealing & Exchange Corp. READ: Alternergy eyes P2B from maiden notes issuance Meanwhile, Alternergy said its debt-market debut saw “strong interest” from investors, even surpassing its target issue size. “Our maiden issuance in the Philippine debt capital markets is an important milestone in Alternergy’s journey and reflects the strength of the platform we have built,” Vincent Perez, Jr., Alternergy’s chair, said in […]...
